text:
morgan: Heads-up: compliance asks for a guaranteed 'who changed what' stream for routing policies / quotas. They want near‑realtime export to SIEM (<=5s). How do we deliver this without massively increasing egress/costs?
sasha: We currently batch audit events into 1m NDJSON bundles for retention and exports. Could add a 'hot' realtime stream but only for a subset of events :thinking_face:
devon: Hot stream + full payload = $$$. Suggest compact deltas for realtime (tiny) and full payloads on-demand pulled from blobstore. :thumbsup:
morgan: Compact deltas idea sounds promising. Schema: actor, resource_id, op, ts, change_hash, meta_flags. Need immutability so downstream can reconstruct full event if needed.
julian: Also add a `reconstruct_hint` field that points to either inline diff or a signed blob id. That keeps realtime small but verifiable.
ravi: PII note: many policy changes include free-text justification. We need tenant-configurable redaction modes: `none`, `mask`, `strip`. Exports must respect tenant opt-ins.
devon: Another lever: sampling / priority queue. Admins, automation (terraform/CI) and privileged roles => realtime. Low-risk users => sampled 1/100 or aggregated. Allow manual ad-hoc fetch for full history for 30d.
sasha: Console UX: timeline view with inline expandable diff, actor avatar, and an option to download a signed NDJSON slice. Need anchor timestamps and search-by-change-id. :white_check_mark:
morgan: Operationally we also need ordering guarantees for routing table edits across regions. Changes to routing should be causally ordered in the stream.
julian: We can attach simple causal metadata: change_id, prev_change_id, resource_seq. Not full vector clocks but enough to reconstruct per-resource ordering.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled for `audit-hotstream-v2` at 00:00 UTC. 20% hosts, feature flag `audit.hot_stream` toggled.
ravi: Quotas: per-tenant export quotas and egress rate limits. Also automatic billing alerts if realtime egress exceeds threshold.
morgan: Prototype plan: 1) compact realtime schema + sample rules, 2) NDJSON full-export-on-demand + signed bundles, 3) tenant redaction flags, 4) causal metadata for ordering. Volunteers to spike?
sasha: I can spike compact schema and mock console timeline (small prototype).
devon: I'll take producer throttling, sampling rules, and cost sim.
julian: I'll prototype `change_id`/`prev_change_id` headers and a tiny verification tool for signed bundles.
morgan: Nice. Also include an example event formats for review.
sasha: Example compact realtime delta:
```
{"change_id":"c_20260301_0001","actor":"alice@example.com","resource":"routing-policy:us-east-1","op":"update","ts":"2026-03-01T00:01:02Z","delta":"+route:gpu->pool-b","reconstruct_hint":"blob://audit/20260301/c_20260301_0001.full.json.sig"}
```
devon: Example full NDJSON event (exportable, signed):
```
{"change_id":"c_20260301_0001","actor":"alice@example.com","actor_role":"org.admin","resource":"routing-policy:us-east-1","op":"update","ts":"2026-03-01T00:01:02Z","before":{"routes":[{"id":"gpu","pool":"pool-a"}]},"after":{"routes":[{"id":"gpu","pool":"pool-b"}]},"justification":"ops: needed capacity rebalance","signature":"sig_v1_..."}
```
morgan: Great — please open PRs under `platform/audit-stream` with README + schema docs. We'll sync progress in the eng sync next Wed 10:00am.
sasha: Acked, will add a small console mock and sample queries.
devon: Adding perf numbers to the spike to validate cost model.
julian: I'll add a small verifier cli and docs on how to verify signed bundles.
morgan: Thanks all. If anyone hits regulatory edgecases (GDPR/legal), ping ravi and attach sample payloads.
ravi: Will do. Also draft a small compliance FAQ for tenants explaining redaction modes and export costs.
